channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran refutes Trump’s claim to ‘control’ Hormuz: What’s the latest in talks?
item.description: Iran says Hormuz stays closed until US meets its demands and changes its 'behaviour' as global energy prices rise.

item.title: Four killed in overnight attacks in southern Russia, Ukraine
item.description: Russia's Novorossiysk 'endured a horrific night', with a child killed and dozens of buildings damaged, says local mayor.

item.title: Trump says his decoy plane faced ‘greater risk’ in secret flight change
item.description: Air Force One was still carrying journalists and top aides, who remained at apparent risk of an Iranian strike.

item.title: Israeli raids, arrests continue as UN warns West Bank at ‘breaking point’
item.description: Israeli forces arrest 23 Palestinians and demolish home of man killed in confrontation with Israeli settlers in July.

item.title: Did Trump flee an Iranian assassination plot on a catering truck?
item.description: New reports reveal the US President hid in a catering truck to switch planes over an alleged bomb plot in July.

item.title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
item.description: It marks another striking episode in the turbulent history of his relationship with Iran, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

item.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
item.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

item.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
item.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

item.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
item.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.

item.title: Watch: Why was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
item.description: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.
